packet_dag.terminal_condition: The UI build remains blocked until authenticated Operations evidence, member/latest-video evidence, and Vimeo/provider publication blockers are resolved or explicitly carried.

title: One Time content-processing and latest-video UI readiness spec

reasons: The parent workflow asks for Drive-to-classroom visibility across provider review, classroom, parent, student, and member/latest-video surfaces.
Current-state screenshots now exist for public/provider/parent/student/classroom review surfaces across the required viewports.
Authenticated Operations and member/latest-video proof is incomplete, so implementation must remain blocked or split.
affected_product_surfaces: Operations One Time content library and tasks
likely_external_provider_blockers: Vimeo private upload needs test folder/project, upload-capable user token/scope/plan confirmation, and explicit synthetic smoke approval.
Member/latest-video proof needs either a non-hanging member route capture or valid member test session.
recommended_packet_sequence: Resolve authenticated Operations screenshot blocker or carry it as an explicit UI blocker.
Resolve member/latest-video screenshot blocker or identify the correct member-library route.
Split implementation into Operations review-package UI and portal/latest-video UI packets.
Run focused tests, action/route watchdogs, deploy, and live smoke for any app-visible change.
ramble_router.next_exact_packet: PKT-20260713-004-07A Operations content-processing review UI after blockers

operator_intent_summary: Define the UI readiness contract for One Time content-processing, class review, latest-video, and older-library surfaces without editing UI code until visual evidence, state matrices, provider gates, and publication blockers are explicit.
raw_quotes: Drive drop -> stable-file detection -> exactly-once content job -> conservative edge edit -> private timestamped transcript -> title/description/Torah metadata -> bot-knowledge handoff -> private/unlisted Vimeo upload -> class review package -> approval-gated member publication -> latest parent/student portal video -> older-class library view.

Produce current-state visual audit and then scoped Rabbi content-processing UI packet with queue/details/review states, action placement, mobile/desktop screenshots, accessibility, action/route registry, tests, deploy/live smoke.

decisions_captured.decision: Vimeo app credentials are valid but a direct upload-capable user token/test target/approval gate is still required before provider upload proof.
UI implementation must split into Operations review-package UI and member/parent/student portal latest-video UI packets.

out_of_scope: No UI implementation in this spec packet.
No Vimeo upload, privacy change, folder attach, metadata edit, delete, or public publish.
No database publication or member entitlement mutation.
No email, WhatsApp, Telegram, payment, access grant, DNS, GHL, LeadConnector, credential, or provider-account mutation.
No raw transcript body, private contact data, secret value, raw provider payload, or private video URL in tracked evidence.

known_current_defects: Authenticated Operations command-center screenshots were not captured because Operations login returned 401 Invalid credentials.
The member/latest-video screenshot route was excluded because one-time-member-login repeatedly hung the screenshot harness.
Student review has unlabeled or empty action controls in all five captured viewports.

Only populated, preview_only, and permission_denied states were directly observed; loading, empty, filtered_empty, error, blocked_setup, success_readback, and mobile detail states need fixtures or smoke paths.
current_state.after_screenshot_plan: After implementation, capture the same five viewport set for every touched route and include authenticated Operations plus member/latest-video evidence or exact blockers.

expanded_phrases.finish everything: Every requirement in RAW-20260713-004 must have a terminal status, evidence, and blockers where external setup prevents completion.
expanded_phrases.make it work: The content pipeline UI must show job queue, review details, blocked setup, preview-only, approval, publish, retry, and latest-video readback states without external writes.
expanded_phrases.portal: Parent, student, and member views must show only entitled approved One Time videos and must not expose provider/support/private records.
expanded_phrases.mobile: 390px and 430px views must show usable navigation, detail/back behavior, readable actions, and no horizontal overflow.
expanded_phrases.pipeline: The UI must represent Drive intake, media edit, transcript, metadata, Vimeo, review, approval, publication, and portal-readback stages as first-party BNA/One Time states.
expanded_phrases.working: A later implementation must pass route/action registry checks, focused tests, screenshots, deploy, and live smoke before any UI Done claim.

product_quality_expansion.user_facing_goal: Rabbi/provider operators can review a prepared class package and families/students can see the latest approved class video without seeing setup internals, private transcripts, or unrelated workspace data.
information_architecture: Operations content library shows queue and review package preparation.
Provider review shows class package details and approval state.
Parent/student/classroom pages show latest approved video and older-class library entry only after publication.
Support-only diagnostics stay behind Operations/support context.

requirements.statement: Prepare a scoped UI implementation plan for One Time content-processing and latest-video surfaces from current-state evidence.
requirements.expected_result: A later Codex packet can implement only one route family at a time with exact states, actions, registry impacts, tests, screenshots, deploy, and live-smoke gates.
acceptance_criteria: Current-state screenshots or exact blockers exist for required desktop/tablet/mobile viewports.
Implementation is split between Operations/provider review and portal/latest-video surfaces.
No provider upload or publication action is represented as available until Vimeo and approval gates pass.
Parent/student/member surfaces remain entitlement-scoped and workspace-isolated.
The student unlabeled-action finding is either fixed in a focused packet or carried as a blocker.

criteria: Current-state visual audit exists with 40 screenshots across 8 active routes and five required viewports.
Operations command-center implementation is blocked until authenticated Operations screenshots are captured or the blocker is explicitly accepted.
Member/latest-video implementation is blocked until the hanging member-login route is replaced with a valid member/latest-video route or session.
PQC validator must pass before any UI code edit.
Vimeo upload and member publication remain separate approval-gated packets.

loading.how_to_enter_state: Open content library before the queue/review package payload finishes loading.
loading.expected_visible_message: Loading content jobs and review packages.
loading.aria_semantic_expectation: Loading region has readable status text.
loading.test_smoke_assertion: Later smoke intercepts delayed payload and asserts loading state.

empty.how_to_enter_state: Use a fixture with no queued content jobs.
empty.expected_visible_message: No class videos are waiting for review.
empty.aria_semantic_expectation: Empty state is plain text with labeled actions.
empty.test_smoke_assertion: Later fixture smoke asserts empty state copy.

populated.how_to_enter_state: Open classroom review route with seeded review data.
populated.expected_visible_message: Latest approved class package is visible with video, worksheet, and class metadata.
populated.aria_semantic_expectation: Video and worksheet sections have headings.
populated.accessibility_expectation: Video actions have labels and no mobile overflow.
populated.test_smoke_assertion: Captured classroom review screenshots exist for five viewports.

filtered_empty.how_to_enter_state: Apply a filter that matches no content jobs.
filtered_empty.accessibility_expectation: Filter bar wraps without horizontal overflow.
filtered_empty.test_smoke_assertion: Later fixture smoke asserts filtered-empty state.

error.how_to_enter_state: Use a fixture or network intercept that returns a safe content-library error.
error.expected_visible_message: Could not load class video queue.
error.aria_semantic_expectation: Error region announces failure and retry action.
error.test_smoke_assertion: Later fixture smoke asserts safe error text.

blocked_setup.how_to_enter_state: Open tasks/decisions while Vimeo private upload gate is unresolved.
blocked_setup.expected_visible_message: Vimeo private upload needs owner/test-project approval.
blocked_setup.aria_semantic_expectation: Blocked setup state is readable as text, not color-only.
blocked_setup.test_smoke_assertion: Audit captured Operations tasks route in all five viewports, but authenticated proof is blocked by OPS login.

preview_only.how_to_enter_state: Open provider review route before publication approval.
preview_only.expected_visible_message: Class package is available for review but not published.
preview_only.test_smoke_assertion: Audit captured provider review in all five viewports.

success_readback.how_to_enter_state: Open parent review after an approved class package exists.
success_readback.expected_visible_message: Latest approved class video is visible for the entitled family.
success_readback.aria_semantic_expectation: Latest-video area has heading and labeled playback action.
success_readback.accessibility_expectation: No mobile overlap with bottom controls.
success_readback.test_smoke_assertion: Later live smoke must prove approved latest-video readback.

permission_denied.how_to_enter_state: Run the audit without a valid Operations session.
permission_denied.aria_semantic_expectation: Auth blocker is clear and does not expose private data.
permission_denied.test_smoke_assertion: Current audit observed permission_denied for Operations because login returned 401.

mobile_drawer_or_detail_state.how_to_enter_state: Open student review route on 390px mobile and open a detail/drawer path if available.
mobile_drawer_or_detail_state.expected_visible_message: Latest class and student-safe actions remain readable.
mobile_drawer_or_detail_state.accessibility_expectation: Fix current unlabeled/empty student action finding before UI Done.
mobile_drawer_or_detail_state.test_smoke_assertion: Current audit captured student review mobile and reported unlabeled action controls.

findings.screenshot_after_or_blocker: No after screenshot; UI implementation is blocked before code.
findings.user_impact: Student mobile action controls may be unclear to keyboard, screen-reader, and touch users.
findings.expected_fix: Give every empty or icon-only student action a visible label, aria-label, title, or a clearly labeled replacement control.

findings.screenshot_after_or_blocker: Authenticated Operations evidence blocked by 401 Invalid credentials.
findings.user_impact: The current audit cannot prove the authenticated Rabbi/provider content command center state.
findings.expected_fix: Provide valid Operations audit credentials or a safe authenticated fixture before implementing Operations command-center UI.

requirements: Every action must have visible text or an accessible name.
Mobile views must avoid horizontal overflow.
Status states must be text-visible and not color-only.
Video, worksheet, review, and publication sections need headings.
known_findings: Student review unlabeled/empty actions across five viewports.
